Service 05

Conversion Rate Optimization.

Turning traffic into revenue

Overview

Traffic without conversion is a leak, not a channel. We audit the funnel end to end (landing pages, product pages, checkout), identify where visitors actually drop off, and run structured tests against real data rather than opinions about what "should" convert better.

Ideal for

Stores and funnels already getting traffic that isn't converting at the rate it should.

What’s included

  • Funnel & Store CRO Audits
  • Landing Page & Checkout Optimization
  • A/B & Split Testing
  • On-Site Experience Improvements

Conversion & AOV.

More from the traffic you already have

  • Funnel audits backed by session data
  • Conversion-focused product and cart pages
  • Average order value and bundling work

Is This You

Signs You Need Conversion Rate Optimization.

Traffic is steady or growing but sales aren't following

You've redesigned the store more than once without ever diagnosing why visitors drop off

Mobile and desktop conversion rates are noticeably different

You're making funnel decisions from top-line analytics without session recordings

How We Deliver It

The Process, Step by Step.

Step 01

Funnel & Store CRO Audit

We map the full funnel (landing, product, cart, checkout) to find exactly where visitors drop off, backed by session data, not assumptions.

Step 02

Prioritized Test Plan

Findings become a ranked list of tests, ordered by expected impact so effort goes to the highest-leverage fixes first.

Step 03

Structured A/B Testing

Changes are run as testable improvements against real traffic, so results can be attributed to specific fixes.

Step 04

Iterate on What Wins

Winning tests get rolled out, losing tests get discarded, and the next round of testing starts from what the data just taught us.

FAQ

Common Questions About Conversion Rate Optimization.

How is this different from a redesign?

A redesign is a design decision. CRO is a behavior decision. We test what's actually causing hesitation and fix that, rather than restyling pages that were never the problem.

Do you need a minimum amount of traffic to run tests?

Enough traffic to reach statistical confidence in a reasonable time. We'll assess this during the audit and recommend the right testing approach for your volume.

Is this a one-time project or ongoing?

CRO compounds best as an ongoing process. We typically start with a focused audit and testing sprint, then continue iterating as a retainer.
